{% autoescape off %}# ARAI GO GU: full reference

> ARAI GO GU (อะไรโก๊ะกู) is a Thai web app for learning foreign languages by chatting with "P'Ryu" (พี่ริว), an AI language tutor that explains in Thai. Source: {{ base }}/ . Last reviewed {{ updated|date:"Y-m-d" }}.

## Product facts

- Supported languages: {{ facts.languages }}
- Japanese levels: JLPT N5 to N1; other languages: beginner, intermediate, advanced
- Free trial without an account: {{ facts.guest_limit }} messages per day (text only)
- Free member account: {% if facts.member_limit %}{{ facts.member_limit }} messages per day{% else %}unlimited messages{% endif %}, saved chat history, image upload up to {{ facts.max_image_mb }} MB, "fast" and "in-depth" answer modes
- Maximum message length: {{ facts.max_message_chars }} characters
- Features: grammar correction with explanations, role-play conversations, vocabulary, exam practice (JLPT, TOEIC, HSK), reading and explaining photos of homework or textbooks, text-to-speech, Thai speech input, a learning-progress page (streak, messages per day, top languages), a community with one post per day and AI moderation
- Price: free
- Platform: web app, installable as a Progressive Web App on Android, iOS (Safari, Add to Home Screen) and desktop
- Contact: {{ contact_email }}
